mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the installed stop without the network was most worthwhile: it showed that a successful bench test was not enough to establish that the whole installation worked.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the test rig before preparing the stop button was an unproductive guess; the later compatibility feedback made the required sequence clearer.

surprise.text: The service kit diagnosed and replaced a failed permission relay when I expected it to prepare the cabinet for sensor inspection.

arbitrary.text: The operator's key having no available operation before reporting was configured felt somewhat arbitrary; the result did not explain that dependency.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the independent safety checks and the final working water service made the repair feel consequential, although the premature guesses interrupted the flow.
